subject: Escalation: Ember AI pilot redlines — liability ceiling & warranty variance
messages:
From: Jordan Hayes <jordan@ember.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@ember.ai>
Date: 2027-11-28T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal & redlines for Ember pilot

Hi Logan / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our proposed SOW and a redline that reflects two asks from our side for the pilot: a one-time 25% pilot discount and two contract changes we discussed with Legal:

- Liability cap increased to $2,000,000 (from your standard $1,000,000) for breaches related to data handling for the pilot period.
- A mutual indemnity carve-out for intellectual property claims tied to Ember-developed connectors.
- Warranty shortened to 60 days for performance SLA remedies during pilot (we want a narrower warranty window).

We understand these are non-standard. Ember is moving quickly and can commit to a 12-week pilot and a firm PO on signature. If there is a path to approve these, we can get the PO this week and kick off onboarding.

Attached: ember-redline-v3.pdf (redlines, highlights), Ember-SOW-Draft-2027.docx

Thanks —
Jordan Hayes
Head of Platform Partnerships
Ember AI

[Attachment: Ember-SOW-Draft-2027.docx (DOCX, 72 KB)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal & redlines for Ember pilot

Looping in deal + legal. Jordan attached redlines. Quick read:

- 25% pilot discount is within scope to approve from a commercial perspective with a margin review, but we should tie it to a firm PO and SOW duration.
- Liability cap increase to $2M and the IP indemnity carve-out are material exceptions to our standard risk profile.
- Warranty change to 60 days reduces customer remedies (counter-intuitive for us) but operationally acceptable for pilot provided we add monitoring SLAs.

Marissa / Ava — please advise whether this needs exec approval for the liability/indemnity deviation and whether we can offer a conditional approval (e.g., grant the discount if exec signs and legal signs the redline with additional safeguards).

Attachments forwarded.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Forwarded attachment: ember-redline-v3.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Escalation: Ember AI — request for executive authorization (liability & indemnity)

Vivek / Markus —

We have a high-probability pilot with Ember AI (fast PO) but they require two non-standard legal concessions: raising the liability ceiling to $2M and an IP indemnity carve-out for their connectors. They are also asking for a 25% pilot discount. Internal notes and commercial trade-offs below:

Why they matter:
- Liability: $2M doubles our typical exposure for pilot engagements. Ember handles PII connectors that increase perceived risk on their side.
- IP indemnity carve-out: limits our ability to recover for third-party IP claims tied to their code — Legal flags this as higher than our appetite without additional escrow/insurance language.
- Discount: acceptable if tied to a fixed pilot scope, firm PO, and clear production gating.

Ask: Executive decision required on the liability ceiling and indemnity carve-out. Legal recommends either:
1) Deny the carve-out and keep $1M cap; offer enhanced monitoring/accept a 20% discount, or
2) Approve the $2M cap and limited IP carve-out only if Ember provides evidence of E&O insurance with a waiver of subrogation and we add a hold-harmless clause for Redwood, plus escalate to Finance for a one-time mark-to-goodwill.

We need a decision by Tuesday EOD to meet Ember's procurement timeline.

Attachments: ember-redline-v3.pdf (key redlines highlighted), commercial summary (internal).

Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commercial-summary-ember.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Ember AI — request for executive authorization (liability & indemnity)

Thanks for the clear summary. My read: Ember is strategic for the connector marketplace and the pilot has strong upsell potential. I will approve a limited exception with controls:

- Liability cap: approve $1.75M (compromise) for the pilot only, documented in an amendment and tied to a firm PO and acceptance criteria.
- IP indemnity: no broad carve-out. Approve a narrow, scoped indemnity carve-out limited to Ember-authored connectors only, with a representation & warranty from Ember that they own or have license to those components.
- Insurance: require E&O policy evidence (minimum $5M) prior to signature and include a right to audit.
- Discount: authorize up to 22% pilot discount conditional on PO within 5 business days.

Marissa — please document these controls in the amendment language and get Legal to draft the precise wording. Logan — communicate this to Ember and request their E&O certificate.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Commercial Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan@ember.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, LegalOps <legalops@ember.ai>
Date: 2027-11-30T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal & redlines for Ember pilot — executive response and next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the patience. We've completed internal review and can move forward with the pilot under the following executive-approved terms:

1) Liability cap: $1.75M for the pilot period (executive-approved, pilot-only).
2) IP indemnity: we will accept a narrowly scoped Ember-authored-connector carve-out provided Ember represents and warrants ownership or license for those connectors.
3) Insurance: please share your E&O certificate evidencing at least $5M in coverage prior to signature.
4) Discount: we can offer a 22% one-time pilot discount, conditional on receipt of a PO within five business days and execution of the amended SOW.

Legal will send an amendment with exact language (Marissa / Legal copied). If you can confirm E&O and PO timing, we will send DocuSign for the SOW.

Next steps: share E&O and PO — I will route the amendment to DocuSign.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
